row.name: Raise the Bar Mobile Bar Services
row.summary: A Glasgow mobile cocktail bar company supplying a mixologist, a fully stocked bar and a printed menu for weddings, parties and corporate events, plus cocktail masterclasses and whisky tastings across Scotland.
facts: Travel within 30 miles of Glasgow included

packages: A fully staffed mobile cocktail bar: mixologist, bar, printed menu, spirits, mixers, garnishes, ice and glassware. 3 hours of service. Choose your cocktails as add-ons.
A hands-on class led by professional mixologists, at your venue, for teams, hen parties and private groups. Alcohol-free options available.
A guided Scotch whisky tasting led by kilted hosts, with distillery stories and a curated selection of drams.
faq: A professional mixologist, a fully stocked mobile bar, a bespoke printed cocktail menu, spirits, liqueurs, mixers, fresh ingredients, garnishes, ice and all glassware.
Yes, £400 before any travel charge. Travel within 30 miles of Glasgow is included; beyond that a travel charge may apply and is quoted before you confirm.
3 hours from your start time. The team arrives about 30 minutes before to set up. Longer service is quoted on request.
How many cocktails can I choose?
Up to 6 online. For a longer menu, or drinks that are not on the menu, ask for a bespoke menu.
Yes, with a minimum of 5 of each cocktail, and the £400 minimum booking still applies.

A £50 deposit secures the request and the team confirm within 48 hours. The balance is invoiced and due within 14 days, and no later than 72 hours before the event. The deposit is non-refundable if you cancel, and refunded in full if they cannot attend.
About 1.6 m by 1 m, with working room needed behind it. The front can be branded for an extra fee.
Yes, they hold public liability insurance and can share proof on request.
